findings.note: Fixed and tested: a session that ran close is marked closed in its ledger record; mark_open takes over its stale marker silently (both routes: marker pushed before the close, and marker left on a second project), and repair_unclosed never replaces a real record with an 'unrecorded' stub. The packet's repro through the command line prints no 'earlier session' line and keeps the real ledger. Remains: close still does not push what it writes (not in decision 3; the push functions are package A's). So in a new container whose brain clone does not hold the session's inbox record, the next boot still records a gap. That needs close to run before the last checkpoint --push, or A's end-of-session command. The proposed detect change (no mark_open in mode 'choose') is also A's.

close without --tier takes the size from the head of the project's .brain/STATE.md, then the manifest's tier; --tier still overrides. The outcome and ledger records carry it and the sizing learner gets a label after folding.
Nothing to do: common.helper_transcripts and tests/test_helper_transcripts.py were already in the tree and pass in the whole-suite run.

The session-end hook now captures into learning/inbox/.live/<date>-<session>.jsonl (added to .gitignore) and writes nothing tracked, nothing in the project, and leaves the open marker in place. capture merges tracked and live records, close writes the tracked record and removes the live file, repair reads the live file first, then the transcript, then keeps a real record, then writes the gap. close also promotes live files of other sessions that died (with no project there is no marker to trigger a repair). Not wired, because state.py is A's: checkpoint --push should call ledger.promote_live() (see cross_package); until then a session that never closes and loses its container loses its ledger.

In a locked brain the hook asks the owner for a kernel path (PreToolUse 'ask', exit 0), refuses VERSION.json, .claude/hooks/, .claude/settings.json and engine/guard.py, reads notebook_path, and refuses a shell command that appears to write a learned-zone path or a lock file (pattern check, said so in the docstring; I extended it to the lock files because sed -i on VERSION.json was the same hole). guard diff fails when the base was locked and the tree is not. zone_of ignores case. Unlocked brain: no output, exit 0. Not done, not in the decisions: --strict-kernel and a CI label step.

instruction_notes: docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md:95: 'capture (`close` or the Stop hook) clears this session's marker; `repair_unclosed(project, marker)` captures the earlier session from its transcript if it is still on disk, else appends a `ledger` record with `unrecorded: true`'. Now: only close (a tracked capture) clears the marker; the Stop hook's live capture leaves it. mark_open(project, sid, brain_root) returns None for a marker whose session ran close. repair order: closed, nothing; live file; transcript; a real tracked record is kept; else the unrecorded record.

docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md:63: '... what `close` and the Stop hook do when they re-record a session.' The Stop hook no longer rewrites the tracked inbox file; it writes learning/inbox/.live/<date>-<session>.jsonl, which git ignores. close, a repair and ledger.promote_live are what rewrite the tracked file.

docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md:40: the `ledger` record also has `active_minutes`, `tokens_oe`, `closed: true` when written by close, and `unpriced_models` when a model was priced at the fallback rate. Line 41: the `outcome` record also has `tokens_oe`, `tokens_oe_all` and `active_minutes` (null with usage unknown), and `tier` defaults to the project's STATE.md, then the manifest.

remaining: Everything is committed on r4/e at e6e1706 and the tree is clean. Not done, with the owner of each: (1) close does not push what it writes, so core-03 still shows a gap in a new container whose brain clone lacks the session's record (A or K). (2) checkpoint --push does not yet call ledger.promote_live(), so an unclosed session's capture does not survive its container (A; one line). (3) mlearn does not yet use tokens_oe and active_minutes (G). (4) req.load does not reject a repeated id (D). (5) --strict-kernel and a CI owner-label step were not built (not in the decisions). Three choices I made that the lead may want to reverse: active_minutes caps each long gap at five minutes, which gives 12 for the finding's two-burst example where its acceptance says 7; the 'tests' fact counts test functions in the code instead of reading the last recorded run; the Stop hook's live capture no longer writes the project's run record or STATUS.md and no longer clears the open marker, because a provisional capture must leave the session repairable and the project tree clean. Behaviour worth knowing when merging: lint's default output is now six lines (five note lines) until the 26 trigger phrases, the models.json limit and the agent token lines are fixed.
